# The first FirstRun module forces a Boolean that Account Hub samples only after its open guards

The owned FirstRun module returns a forced Boolean, initially false, and lets tests set it. Account Hub samples it only after the minimized-restore and reset guards, before loading the requested view, then caches the result and modal class. The added test changes the forced value while open and expects the cached true value until a later successful open resamples false. Its reset is manual rather than a cleanup hook for earlier exits. This is the dummy introduction and its direct assertions, not profile detection, a successful module load or a reproduced failure. Accepted real-predicate behavior and the exact subsequent backout remain separate phases.

Scope: Account Hub first-run introduction phases.
